formal: My partner and I have been together for eight months. They have asked me to move into their flat. The plan is for me to give notice on my current residence next week and to be added to their tenancy next month. I know what I want from sharing a home, I have weighed the matter carefully, and I have made my decision. I rarely bring decisions concerning my home or my relationship to you, so this is unusual for me. What is your view?
